title: Fresh-chat reincarnation test harness
mission: Design and, where practical, implement tests/harnesses proving a fresh chat can resolve a durable Chat Object and recover mission/design/rules/frontier/work state without depending on the old transcript, while still using conversation history only as optional archaeology.
must_preserve: fresh chat should not need old transcript
deliver: how to test active worker state survives parent reincarnation
done_when: Parent has an executable or implementation-ready acceptance harness covering fresh Home -> Chat Object -> exact frontier and worker-state recovery.
